title: Final: layout
cards/0/task: An editor: a 200 px tree on the left, a 100 px panel on the right, and the preview in the middle takes the rest.
cards/1/task: Build the window to match the sample.
cards/2/q: Photo tiles should fill a row and wrap to the next one. Which panel?
cards/2/explain: Wrapping into rows is what WrapPanel does.
cards/3/q: Columns are "Auto,*". The first column's content is 120 px, the window is 500 px. What are the widths?
cards/3/explain: Auto takes 120, the star takes the rest.
cards/4/q: Which line makes the status bar sit to the right of the menu instead of spanning the full width at the bottom?
cards/4/code:
<DockPanel>
  <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top"> Header </Border>
  <Border DockPanel.Dock="Left"> Menu </Border>
  <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom"> Status </Border>
  <Border> Content </Border>
</DockPanel>
cards/4/explain: The menu is docked before the status bar, so it took the left strip all the way down. Move the status bar above the menu.
cards/5/q: Three columns: fit to content, the rest, exactly 150
cards/5/explain: Columns go from left to right.
cards/6/q: Match each task to its solution
cards/7/q: Who decides how big a button will be?
cards/7/options/0: The button says how much it needs, and the parent panel hands out the final rectangle
cards/7/explain: Measure is a request. Arrange is the parent's decision.
